Corresponding source for replies.bin, retained unmodified. This file is not
compiled; build.rs compiles only C files directly under vendor/playfair/.

Origin: https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay/blob/15a6b87172eca38b0df4e615fbf1bba108734dde/lib/fairplay_playfair.c
Revision: 15a6b87172eca38b0df4e615fbf1bba108734dde

The production Rust implementation uses the checked extracted reply table and
bounded protocol state machine. This source accompanies distribution so that
the table's original source and notices remain available without a local cache.
